_purpose: Lead list for Warmode (agentic growth harness) and AJ's fractional/project growth consulting. These are companies SIGNALING revenue-growth need by hiring growth roles (Growth PM, Head/VP of Growth, Growth Engineer). NOT a job-application list (that is browser_finds.json). Bar is intentionally lower than full-time targets. Target profile: seed-Series C, preferably AI-native, not fully sales-led.
_caveats: Stage / ai_native / gtm_motion are BEST-EFFORT inferences from the job listing plus general knowledge, NOT independently verified this run. Treat as starting hypotheses to confirm before outreach.
